notes.title: Spooky Express will release on October 21st! 🎃
notes.notes: [p][i]All aboard the Spooky Express![/i][/p][p]Our newest game will be be pulling into the station on [b]October 21st, 2025 [/b]🎃[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45613242/ae096275ed36a1d1ae8b7fd51d4e66ba6d0c68c1.gif"][/img][/p][p][i]Take charge of the Spooky Express; the only rail service willing to carry the undead passengers of deepest, darkest Trainsylvania. In your new role, you'll plan routes and lay train tracks to meet your creepy commuters' demands, and create a rail network spanning more than 150 thoughtfully designed levels.[/i] [/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45613242/9d0f41e19ed4f6bbd1da06c4d4506b98cd89a6c1.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]Additionally we're excited to announce that Spooky Express will also be available on mobile devices. [url="https://apps.apple.com/app/id6738424828"]Pre-order Spooky Express on iOS[/url], now, or [url="https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=express.spooky"]pre-register on Android[/url][b] to be notified[/b] once it's available.[/p][p]To celebrate the launch date, we've added a [url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3352310/Spooky_Express/"]new and improved demo[/url] you can play right here on Steam. If you've already played the demo, the puzzles will be the same but we've added quality of life improvements, and an intro comic introducing the narrative. [/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45613242/704a6d38529c21a325c097d37ac2356bb5f4ce62.png"][/img][/p][p]if you want to help share the news, you can do so on [url="https://bsky.app/profile/draknek.bsky.social"]BlueSky[/url], [url="https://mastodon.gamedev.place/@draknek"]Mastodon[/url] and check out the announcement trailer.[/p][p][/p][previewyoutube="mV1eSyI8XA8;full"][/previewyoutube][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3352310/Spooky_Express/"][/dynamiclink][/p]

notes.title: Play the Spooky Express demo NOW 🦇
notes.notes:
We're excited to announce that the demo for Spooky Express is OUT NOW!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3352310/Spooky_Express/

Plan the train route for the world’s spookiest theme park! Transport monsters to their destinations — but keep everything [i]on track[/i] and don’t let them bite the passengers or you’ll have a [i]grave[/i] problem.

This is our first ever demo for Spooky Express, and we're excited to invite you to play. The demo's features include:

[list]
[*] More than 35 levels of the theme park to explore and build tracks for
[*] Three colourful characters, which is just a sneak preview of the full game
[*] A fantastic soundtrack by Priscilla Snow
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45613242/ae096275ed36a1d1ae8b7fd51d4e66ba6d0c68c1.gif[/img]

This demo will be available for a limited time and will be participating in not one but two upcoming events on Steam:

[list]
[*] Vampires vs. Zombies Festival
[*] [url=https://www.cerebralpuzzleshowcase.com/]The Cerebral Puzzle Showcase[/url]
[/list]

And last but not least... If you haven't already, please don't forget to wishlist Spooky Express!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3352310/Spooky_Express/

notes.title: We're excited to announce the next game from Draknek & Friends: Spooky Express
notes.notes:
Hey there!

We're incredibly excited to announce the newest game we're developing here at Draknek & Friends is [b]Spooky Express[/b]!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/7938465/83e82ab61856c744ba366a8e814e5b0fc8468bd8.png[/img]

Plan the train route for the world’s spookiest theme park!
All the passengers are all just [i]dying[/i] to ride the Spooky Express.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/7938465/ae096275ed36a1d1ae8b7fd51d4e66ba6d0c68c1.gif[/img]

Pick up the creepy cryptids and drop them at their destinations around the park. But be careful! Don’t let them scare or bite the human passengers. Stay [i]on track[/i] of the situation or you’ll have a [i]grave[/i] problem.

Spooky Express is great follow-up to our award-winning thinky puzzle game, [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/583270/Cosmic_Express/]Cosmic Express[/url] and will feature over 100 unique levels with countless monsters, maps and mechanics.

If you’ve liked our past games, we’re confident you’ll love this one too.

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=uewJWzD6s10

If you’re excited for the game don't forget to wishlist!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3352310/Spooky_Express/

...And that's not all. If you want to hear even more about Spooky Express, we've just released a special episode of the [url=https://www.draknek.org/podcast]Draknek & Friends Official Podcast[/url]. Tune in wherever you get your podcasts to hear creative director Alan Hazelden and producer Syrenne McNulty chat to the level designer Lucas Le Slo about the development of the game, and some of the other projects he's involved in.

Until next time 👋
